text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(The rain was cold, my legs felt heavy... 
Even so, the heat beside me burned just as 
intensely!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I see... So this is the Satsuki Sho! The 
fiery battle to claim the Triple Crown――!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahaha...! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (Thank you, Ace!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa, haa!! *Gasp*, haa...!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I... won. Did I win? I won! For real!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectators
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh--!?

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
T-The dream of the Triple Crown is over... 
It's way too soon...!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, but... that was great. You didn't take 
1st, but I was totally captivated.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That final straight was totally insane! 
It looked like all the other Umamusume 
were standing still!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, true. Mr. C.B. ran a great race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Siiigh............ Yeah, I've got no clue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The turf was an exceptionally heavy track, 
and by the time she passed through the 
tunnel, she was covered in mud from head 
to toe.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, there really are times when you can't 
even open your eyes. I'm so glad we have a 
shower.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Honestly, I was so frustrated. 
But it all washed away down the shower 
drain.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Ace was strong today. In that case, 
I'll just pay back the debt at the next 
Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was a blast. I'm sure the 
next one will be too. Yeah... I'm fired 
up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Derby, where I've sworn to take 
revenge, is the battle to decide the 
pinnacle of our generation. I have to run 
through it without letting my guard 
down...!
